families.reason: Webhook, method policy, trials and activation are authorization/elegibility boundaries.
No cross-tenant selector or tenant-scoped storage contract is introduced.
Checkout navigation, method publication and webhook ingress are public boundaries.
Persisted provider ids are dereferenced later during reconciliation and retry.
Payment/trial/event order and uncertain outcomes depend on authoritative timing.
Trial first charge and discount duration target future billing dates.
Retry, multiple tabs and double-click must converge on one provider effect.
Retries and duplicate events must not duplicate effects.
Failures remain pending/recoverable; no multi-resource rollback contract is specified.
No versioned immutable-history contract is specified by this adapter issue.
Asaas stays isolated and provider-neutral/catalog authority is preserved.
Runbook, observability and sandbox validation are explicit deliverables.
